design: Under attack: "Learned conditional world model serving Monte Carlo leaf evaluation" — a generator G_theta(r_{t+1..t+h} | x_t) of the joint forward-return path on the PIT ~273-asset true-UTC daily Kraken panel (market-residual, Yang-Zhang-standardised target), conditioned on a 60-day OHLCV window, in three arms: (a) closed-form conditional Gaussian/copula (ridge mean, HAR-RV/YZ vol, Ledoit-Wolf/DCC covariance), (b) neural conditional flow/diffusion or RSSM over 21-day x N-asset blocks, (c) Bella re-conditioned on daily bars (new build — the resident Bella is a minute-bar, 64-survivor-asset, window-400 generator with a broken 1440-step path and a 7x-too-easy oracle ratio; receipts verified: diff_teacher/data_loader.py:155 `WHERE a.is_active = 1`, :183/:219 `FROM ohlcv`, diff_teacher/CLAUDE.md:8-9, lore/notes_2026-05-18.md:79-96). Use: leaf V_K(w) = (1/K) sum_k u(w.r^k − c|w − w_prev|) over K sampled paths with the KNOWN inventory/fee dynamics, inside either the existing pw0.0 sampled search (E5-inversion3 shape) or a sample-average approximation of the Garleanu-Pedersen program. The proposal's own position: profit source = forecast; not BEAR-positive without a forecast; alpha odds 1-2%; honest uses = (1) calibrated null engine for the memo's §4 IC instrument, (2) R4 stress/sizing, (3) execution calibration; a 4-stage pre-registered kill experiment (IC of rollout mean vs ridge, QLIKE vs HAR-RV, MC-leaf vs GP closed form, 758 oracle-PnL-ratio disqualifier), <=1 GPU-day on one 24 GB card.
lens: AMPLIFIER-NOT-SOURCE. I assumed the loop can only amplify information present in its training targets (observed return paths under a likelihood/score objective) and asked, for every claimed role, whether the learned object carries anything a direct estimator on the same inputs lacks; redid the proposal's noise arithmetic; checked every literature number for gross-vs-net, in-sample-vs-OOS, years, seeds (Yu 2019 read in full incl. supplementary Table 2; Aghapour 2025 v4 read in full via extracted text; Moreira-Muir and Cederburg at abstract level); re-read every cited LEDGER row and repo receipt in the primary file. Additional check, because the operator's question is about LOOPS: does the design contain a self-learning loop at all, and if not, does it answer the question or dissolve it.
strongest_objection: The design's learned object carries nothing about the numerator that a ridge on the same 60-day window lacks — the proposal concedes this by iterated expectations — and the two roles it keeps for itself are BOTH dominated by direct, model-free tools, so under the amplifier lens nothing survives that requires the generator. (i) Null engine (the proposal's highest-odds item, 60-70%): a per-date block-Rademacher sign flip of the residual forward-return panel (one sign per date-block of length h, applied to all assets) preserves cross-sectional correlation, N_eff, vol clustering, tails and the feature-magnitude dependence EXACTLY, with zero fitting variance, and sets E[y|x]=0 by construction; the circular-shift placebo already on the record (lore/fable_tactics_panel_2026-09-04.md:115) does the same for a different null. The proposal's own construction fails its stated goal: "returns sign-randomised per (date, asset)" destroys the cross-sectional correlation it claims to preserve (a random per-asset sign decorrelates the market factor), and "drift term constrained to zero" is ill-posed for a flow/diffusion whose conditional mean is implicit — a zero-drift SDE with a nonlinear score network still encodes a conditional mean through conditional skew, and removing it requires estimating E[r|x], i.e. the forecaster. The memo's E-2 defect (`cap_aggregate.py:46-57`, max of four shuffled draws) is a DRAW-COUNT defect, cured by 200+ model-free draws, not by a learned generator that adds estimation error plus the 758-class artefact risk to the threshold itself. (ii) R4 stress/sizing is arm (a) — closed-form conditional Gaussian/copula with Ledoit-Wolf/DCC — which is a direct estimator, not a loop; and the one in-repo sizing measurement went the other way (inverse-vol −0.06 Sharpe, turnover 0.155→0.181, `runs/819_single_asset/PORTFOLIO_RESULT.md:48`, panel :73-74). (iii) The design is not a self-learning loop: the generator is fitted once by supervised likelihood; there is no self-play, no distillation, no policy trained on its own targets. The only loop-shaped variant — training a policy inside the generator (Dreamer) — is the one the proposal itself disqualifies (758 oracle-PnL 7x, notes_2026-05-18.md:87-96; SFAG >2000% GAN backtests). So the design answers the operator's question by deleting the loop; it cannot be cited as "a self-learning loop that survives the record". It is the memo's §4 instrument wearing a generator — and its kill experiment's Stage-1 estimator (rollout mean at K=512) attenuates a true IC of 0.02 to ≈0.008, so the pre-registered comparison against ridge is biased to KILL by construction (arithmetic in kill_experiment_critique).
amplifier_check: VERDICT: amplifier only; creates no information; in two places it amplifies noise or artefacts into turnover. Reasoning. (1) Numerator: the generator is trained by likelihood/score matching on observed paths; E[r|x] is recovered as a by-product of fitting the full conditional law, spending parameters on marginals, dependence and tails. A regression targeted at E[r|x] is the efficient estimator of that quantity on the same inputs; the generator's implied mean has >= its variance and, if misspecified, bias. So mu_G <= ridge/GBM in information — the proposal says so, and the record's only direct read is CONSISTENT WITH INDISTINGUISHABLE, not "nonlinear <= linear" (see record_conflicts #1). (2) Denominator/cost terms: Sigma(x), tails and persistence are directly estimable (HAR-RV, Yang-Zhang, DCC, Ledoit-Wolf, copulas) — arm (a) IS the direct estimator, so the neural arms add only "joint coherence", which is repackaging, not new information. By iterated expectations E[gross] = sum_t E[w_t . mu_t] for every causal w, so none of (2)-(4) touches expected return; vol-timing re-times an existing premium (Moreira-Muir abstract: "changes in factor volatilities are not offset by proportional changes in expected returns"), and Cederburg et al. 2020's abstract says real-time versions "generally earn lower certainty equivalent returns and Sharpe ratios than ... the original, unmanaged portfolios" — the channel is weaker than the proposal quotes. (3) Where it amplifies noise: the MC leaf turns rollout noise into selection error — the argmax over K_cand noisy leaf values is biased upward by ~sigma_noise·sqrt(2 ln K_cand) (optimiser's curse) and the selected book's realised value is below its estimate; that converts noise into turnover, which is exactly 831x/D (K16 +5.29 → K128 +4.68, monotone) and E5-inversion2's churn (hold 55-68%, −4.88/−1.44 at fee16) — with a TRUE-env leaf. Common random numbers shrink the noise on local comparisons but do not remove the curse. (4) Where it amplifies artefacts: any generator artefact becomes "edge" inside the tree (758: Bella oracle PnL 0.0124/step vs 0.0017 historical; SFAG >2000% ann. returns on GAN paths). (5) Literature confirms the accounting rather than rescuing it. Yu et al. 2019 (full text): fees 20 bp + 50 bp slippage, 7 US equities + cash (8 assets incl. cash; footnote 1 names six, Fig. 3 adds Amgen), train 2005-01-01..2016-12-31, test 2017-01-01..2018-12-04, single run, no CIs; Table 1 Sharpe CRP 0.57 / Baseline 0.56 / IPM 0.61 / DAM 0.57 / BCM 0.57 / IPM+DAM 0.59 / IPM+BCM 0.61 / DAM+BCM 0.57 / All 0.63; ann. return 7.14%→8.09%, MDD 13.80%→12.40% — the generator (DAM) adds 0.00-0.01, the forecaster (IPM) supplies the lift. Table 2 (PPO) Baseline 0.37 / BCM 1.13 / IPM+BCM 1.26 verified. Aghapour-Bayraktar-Yuan v4 (full text): FF-10 monthly, 15-stage annual walk-forward 2010-03..2025-02, "long-only and fully invested, rebalanced monthly, and exclude transaction costs", "fixed-seed experiment"; Table 4 Sharpe S&P 0.8180, EW 0.8831, HistMarkowitz 0.7892, GenMarkowitz 0.9246 (vol 21.71% vs 16.71%), HistTD3 0.5523, ParametricTD3 0.7187, MarkovTD3 0.8657, NoCorrectorGenTD3 1.0025, GenTD3 1.2246 (ann. 18.79%, MDD −15.71%); Table 5 (FF-30) EW 0.7391, HistMarkowitz 0.7325, GenMarkowitz 1.0450, GenTD3 1.0964. The proposal omitted the ablations, which are the tell: the short-context generator (MarkovTD3 0.8657) sits BELOW equal-weight; the gain appears only with long-history conditioning — i.e. when the generator carries a momentum-like conditional mean. A forecaster's gain, gross of costs, long-only, one seed. Net: no external result shows a generator adding to a forecaster at honest costs.

record_conflicts.receipt: Proposal worth_if_ic_is_zero: 'daily expected book return ~IC x sigma_book ~7 bp; MC noise at K=256 is 3.5%/16 ~22 bp ... K >~ 2500'; memo §1.3 Grinold-Kahn IR = IC·sqrt(BR)·TC with N_eff 5-15
record_conflicts.conflict: Arithmetic. A book tilted on unit-variance scores across N_eff independent bets earns E ≈ IC·sqrt(N_eff)·sigma_book per period (Grinold), ≈ 20 bp/day at N_eff=8 on a 3.5%/day book, not 7 bp. K for MC noise <= signal is 1/(IC²·N_eff) ≈ 312 at N_eff=8, not 2500; common random numbers shrink it further for local (dithered) moves. The qualitative conclusion — closed form on the same moments has zero MC noise and the noisy argmax pays an optimiser's-curse turnover tax (831x/D) — survives; the number does not.

surviving_claim: What stands after the attack: (1) The bound. For any causal book, E[gross] = sum_t E[w_t . mu_t]; a conditional generator's implied mean is at best the ridge/GBM mean with more variance, so the design's expected return is bounded by the memo's G-A gate (mean IC >= 0.02, NW t >= 3, positive in each of 2024/2025/2026H1) and its net is that minus turnover x 21 bp. It is downstream of the IC instrument, never a way around it, and it is not BEAR-positive without a forecast. (2) The 849 locus (action-blind value leaf, v-hat +0.03) is escaped mechanically by putting the known inventory/fee dynamics in the leaf — but this is E5-inversion3's already-measured result (+8.024 with a true-env leaf, pw0.0), not a contribution of the generator; the 887/892 locus (actions with no edge) is not escaped by any mechanism. (3) Scenario-MC can differ from the Garleanu-Pedersen closed form only under non-quadratic objectives (CVaR/drawdown constraints, proportional-cost no-trade bands) and only on a book that already has drift — a question for the memo's G-B-passes/G-C-fails branch, not before it. (4) Second-moment skill (HAR-RV/Yang-Zhang, DCC) can cut variance and turnover of a book WITH drift; its value on a zero-drift book is 0, its in-repo direction is unmeasured (the one read, inverse-vol, was −0.06), and it needs no learned generator — arm (a) is the direct estimator. (5) The resident Bella cannot serve any daily-surface role as built (minute reader, survivor-only universe, 400-step window, broken 1440 path, 7x-too-easy paths — receipts verified). (6) Nothing in the memo's §4 instrument, including its null distribution, requires the generator: a per-date block sign-flip or circular-shift null with 200+ draws fixes E-2's four-draw floor for free. Operator's question answered plainly: no self-learning loop that "learns patterns to serve Monte Carlo" survives the record, because the pattern MC would need is E[r|x] — which a loop learns no better than a regression — and MC over known inventory dynamics with that mean IS the GP closed form; the loop is redundant at both ends. The only loop-shaped variant (train a policy inside the generator) re-runs 887/892 with a simulator whose artefacts become edge (758).
kill_experiment_critique: Five defects, the first decisive. (1) Stage 1 is biased to KILL by MC attenuation. mu_hat_G is the mean of K=512 rollouts: mu_hat = m + e with var(m) ≈ IC²·sigma² for a calibrated forecast and var(e) = sigma²/K, so the measured IC is the true IC times 1/sqrt(1 + 1/(K·IC²)). At K=512 and IC=0.02: 1/(512·0.0004) = 4.88 → attenuation 0.41 → a generator carrying a true 0.02 reads ≈0.008 and fails both the >= 0.02 bar and the paired test against a noise-free ridge. Attenuation >= 0.9 needs K >= 1/(0.235·IC²) ≈ 10,600; >= 0.95 needs ≈ 23,000. Horizon does not help (signal and MC variance both scale with h). Fix: read the conditional mean analytically for G0, from a mean head or K >= 10^4 for G1/G2 — and the compute line ('seconds per decision on CPU' at K=512) must be re-budgeted (9M block samples through a 10^7-param net with ODE steps = GPU-hours, still inside 1 GPU-day). The proposal did this arithmetic for the leaf and forgot it for its own instrument. (2) The per-year bar is unpowered. IC(mu_G) − IC(ridge) >= +0.01 with paired t >= 3 in EACH of 2024, 2025, 2026H1: with N_eff 8-15 the per-date cross-sectional IC has SD ≈ 0.25-0.35 and the paired difference of two correlated forecasts perhaps 0.15; over ~365 dates SE ≈ 0.008, so t >= 3 needs Δ >= 0.024 per year and >= 0.034 in 2026H1's ~180 dates. A +0.01 true advantage cannot pass; the gate is a pre-registered auto-KILL, not a falsification test. Pre-register a pooled 2024-01..2026-06 NW t with by-year sign consistency (the memo's G-A form) instead. (3) Stage 3 must be conditional on G-A PASS. At IC ≈ 0 both controllers are ≈ 0 and 'MC-leaf <= GP + 0.05 at every K ⇒ retire the search wrapper' fires on noise — a vacuous retirement. It belongs to the memo's G-B-passes branch (the proposal's own open_doubts #5 says so; the kill_experiment text does not). Also an instrument mismatch: Stages 1-2 run on the PIT ~273-asset panel while eval_vector's frame is the survivor-tilted 64-slot ladder (memo :225); the SPEC must say how a 273-asset GP book is quantised into 64 slots or drop the in-env read for Stage 3. (4) Stage 4's band is likely to disqualify the BASELINE arm. The oracle-PnL ratio at fixed variance is a tail statistic (the 42 bp RT oracle harvests exceedances); a conditional-Gaussian G0 with matched variance produces FEWER exceedances than the fat-tailed real panel → ratio plausibly < 0.7 → G0 'disqualified before Stages 1-3 are read', leaving G1 without its comparator. Either exempt G0 (its purpose is mean/covariance, not tails) or use a Student-t/copula G0. Also the 758 'too_easy' protocol (experiments/758_bella_augment/SPEC.md:234-265) is a log-scrape of `[POOL] Loaded ... oracleCumPnL` lines from the minute-Bella training pool, not a standalone harness — porting it to a daily panel is new code inside a 14-day kill date. Stage 4 also tests one moment of realism; add the placebo the proposal half-states: run the same ridge on generated panels and require its IC to match the generator's implied IC within CIs. (5) The pre-committed consequence overreaches in one direction and is missing in the other. KILL closes 'world-model-in-the-tree' — fine — but a Stage-2 PASS 'licenses the null-engine role', which this review shows is dominated by a model-free block sign-flip null; the SPEC should pre-register that null as the comparator and require the generator null to move the Bonferroni threshold materially before it is adopted. Cost and hardware claims are correct in direction: nothing here needs the 64 GB cards, and the whole experiment is an extra column set on the memo's §4 grid — which is the honest framing: the useful part of this kill experiment is the §4 instrument itself.
